title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Tue 27 Oct
summary: A flat day (forecast light). Thermals stayed flat all day. The upslope ran from about 07:45 to about 15:00. A low day for October: the base stayed down near 3,500 ft (normal 4,500–5,400 ft). The evening before, the page called it low, a hit. Midday the base averaged about 3,500 ft by the Kekoa camera; the morning update said about 4,200 ft, off by 700 ft. Most of the day the shear line was north of Pukalani, reaching the coast near Haiku; furthest south about 08:22, crossing Kula Highway between the middle Lower Kula Road junction and Waiakoa. Data gaps: no readings all day from 1 station (Nakula); Kahikinui stopped at 13:55; the Mesonet could not be reached on 14 of 56 updates.
